description:
We’re planning a debt payoff giveaway connected to your opinion about the U.S. economy—not promising to pay everyone’s debt. This video explains the proposed giveaway, the plan to announce a winner soon, and why the official terms need to come before any entry instructions. The amount covered, eligibility, entry deadline, selection process, and payment details have not been provided yet. The proposed giveaway may be canceled at any time, subject to applicable law and official rules. A comment does not guarantee selection or payment. Keep account numbers and other private financial information out of your response. Which monthly bill puts the most pressure on your budget?

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
